decision_authority: Researcher instruction in the project conversation
policy: Exclude schools specifically organized for deaf, hard-of-hearing and/or blind students from the active dual-language research cohort. This includes deaf-education schools with hearing peers. ASL instruction, disability services or inclusion of deaf students alone do not exclude a general school. This is a study-scope decision, not a claim that the school or program closed.
applies_to: All school years in live research views; frozen research releases and source observations remain archived.
